instruction: In this Python repository, bucket() raises an error or behaves incorrectly when the validator is falsey (e.g. None or an empty callable result). The failing test is TestBucket::test_falsey_validator_is_honoured in tests/test_more.py. Investigate the bucket() implementation in more_itertools/more.py, fix it so a falsey validator is honoured, and verify by running the failing test.
